usedFor: HeySummit holds event registrations and MailerLite holds your mailing list, so “New Attendee” can run “Create or Update Subscriber”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Attendee” in HeySummit, then “Create or Update Subscriber” in MailerLite
bestTemplate.why: Every registration lands on your MailerLite list, so you can email attendees about the event.

watchOut: “Ticket Purchased” and “New Attendee” in HeySummit both cover registrations, so pick one trigger to avoid running twice.
